title: Whipped Grass-Fed Tallow Cream — Peaceful Night
body_html:
Nighttime whipped grass-fed tallow cream formulated around skin's overnight repair cycle. Pasture-raised tallow with organic Siberian fir and lavender — grounding, sleep-supportive aromatherapy meets deep lipid repair. No seed oils, no synthetics.

  • Wake up to noticeably softer, more moisturized skin
  • Supports overnight barrier repair without synthetic actives
  • Grounding fir and lavender aromatherapy to wind down before bed
  • Gentle enough for baby skin (patch test first)

How to use: As the final step of your PM routine, warm a pea-sized scoop in palms and press into face, neck, and any dry body patches.

Key ingredients
  • Grass-fed beef tallow — lipid-rich overnight repair; carrier for fat-soluble vitamins
  • Organic olive oil + jojoba oil — squalene, oleic acid, clean absorption
  • Organic Siberian fir oil + lavender oil — grounding, sleep-supportive aromatherapy
Who it's for

Moms who want skincare that doubles as a wind-down ritual. Especially suited to postpartum dryness, seasonal skin fatigue, and sleep-compromised complexions. Good first choice for baby skin (patch test first; consult pediatrician).

Free from

No seed oils • No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates

Why grass-fed tallow

Grass-fed tallow's fatty acids mirror human sebum, so it's recognized and absorbed efficiently — especially overnight when skin is in active renewal mode. Grass-fed adds higher CLA, more fat-soluble vitamins A/D/E/K, and natural vitamin A precursors that support overnight cell turnover without synthetic retinoids.

Full ingredient list (INCI)

Grass-Fed Beef Tallow, Organic Olive Oil, Organic Jojoba Oil, Organic Siberian Fir Oil, Organic Lavender Oil

Size & suggested use

2 oz (56g) · Made in USA · 100% organic oils. External use only; avoid eyes; discontinue if irritation occurs.

faq_json.question: What does this cream smell like?
faq_json.answer: Leaf & Bird's Peaceful Night cream has a grounding, forest-meets-floral scent. Organic Siberian fir leads with a clean, slightly resinous evergreen note — earthy and calming, not sharp. Organic lavender adds a familiar herbal softness underneath. Together the scent is quiet and sleep-supportive. It fades gently within 20–30 minutes of application, so it sets the tone for rest without interfering with sleep.

faq_json.question: Can I use this every night?
faq_json.answer: Yes — this is designed for daily nighttime use. Grass-fed tallow, olive oil, and jojoba oil are all gentle enough for nightly application on face and body. The formula contains no actives that cause purging or sensitivity buildup, so there's no reason to cycle off it. Many users find their skin noticeably softer within the first 1–2 weeks of consistent nightly use.

faq_json.question: Should I apply this before or after serums?
faq_json.answer: Apply tallow cream as the last step of your evening routine, after any water-based serums or treatments. Layering order: cleanse → tone (if used) → treatment serum → tallow cream to seal. Because tallow is lipid-rich, it creates a mild occlusive layer that helps lock in the ingredients beneath it. If you use a retinol treatment, apply the retinol first, wait a few minutes, then apply the cream over it.

faq_json.question: Is this safe to use during pregnancy?
faq_json.answer: The formula contains grass-fed beef tallow, organic olive oil, organic jojoba oil, organic Siberian fir oil, and organic lavender oil — no retinoids, no salicylic acid, no parabens, and no synthetic fragrance. Please consult your OB/GYN or midwife before introducing any new skincare product during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Individual sensitivities vary. This is informational only and not medical advice.

faq_json.question: Can I use this on my baby at bedtime?
faq_json.answer: Many parents reach for simple tallow cream as a gentle overnight moisturizer for babies, and Leaf & Bird's clean formulation makes it a reasonable option. We recommend performing a small patch test on your baby's inner arm first and waiting 24 hours before broader use. Siberian fir and lavender are gentle essential oils, but very young skin can respond differently. Consult your pediatrician before use on infants. This is not medical advice.

faq_json.question: How long does one jar last?
faq_json.answer: A 2 oz jar typically lasts 6–10 weeks at daily facial use. Tallow cream is concentrated — a pea-sized amount softens quickly and covers the full face, neck, and a few dry patches. If you're using it for full-body application nightly, expect 3–4 weeks per jar. Either way, it's a dense, high-value jar relative to what most conventional night creams deliver.

faq_json.question: How much should I use each night?
faq_json.answer: Start with a pea-sized amount for facial and neck coverage. Warm it between your palms for 2–3 seconds and it will soften enough to press and spread evenly. Because tallow is highly concentrated, a small amount goes further than you'd expect. Using more won't improve results — it just means the jar runs out faster. For dry body areas like elbows, heels, or shins, a coin-sized amount per zone is usually sufficient.
